summary: Bitzero Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting a material change: on July 30, 2026, it closed a private placement of 5,828,342 special warrants at US$4.25 each for aggregate gross proceeds of US$24.77 million. Each special warrant automatically converts into one common share and one warrant (exercise price US$5.00, five-year term) upon qualification or after four months and one day. Clear Street acted as placement agent; proceeds will repay debt and fund operations. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
